items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Sidney Desveen, he died just some time ago. He ain't been long past Sidney.

ctx.x: Maybe he had a humbug with the boss or something. It wasn't so good at one record, huh? Well no, it was all right, but it wasn't great, you know. Is that right? It wasn't great. You could do a band with him. He had Amos White and Sidney Desveen. Sidney Desveen, yes.
Sidney Desveen, he died just some time ago. He ain't been long past Sidney. No, not too long.
No, I guess you know about it. Let me turn the machine off a second. Let's see, what were we talking about?
